# StudentHubHelp

> StudentHubHelp is an India-focused student-life discovery platform that helps students explore hostels, PG accommodation, tiffin and mess services, libraries, study spaces, cafes and bookstores in cities and localities where listings are available.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://studenthubhelp.in/) — Student-services discovery
- [Global search](https://studenthubhelp.in/global-search.html) — Search listings by category, city, locality, road, coaching institute or landmark
- [Explore listings](https://studenthubhelp.in/explore-listings.html) — Browse available student-service listings
- [All properties](https://studenthubhelp.in/property-index.html) — Directory of canonical property detail pages
- [Hostel and PG finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/pg-finder.html) — Hostels and paying guest accommodation
- [Tiffin and mess finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/tiffin-finder.html) — Tiffin and meal services
- [Library finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/library-finder.html) — Libraries and study spaces
- [Cafe finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/cafe-finder.html) — Cafes
- [Bookstore finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/bookstore-finder.html) — Bookstores and stationery
- [About StudentHubHelp](https://studenthubhelp.in/about.html) — Platform purpose and student-services discovery
- [Student guide](https://studenthubhelp.in/student-guide.html) — Practical checks for choosing accommodation and student services
- [Parent guide](https://studenthubhelp.in/parent-guide.html) — Questions parents can use when evaluating student services
- [Student support appointments](https://studenthubhelp.in/appointment.html) — Student support and appointment requests
- [Contact StudentHubHelp](https://studenthubhelp.in/contact-us.html) — Contact and support

## Location-based discovery

- City, category, locality and coaching-related directory pages are published only where qualifying listing data is available.
- Canonical property detail URLs use the pattern https://studenthubhelp.in/properties/{category}/{slug}/.
- Use Global Search to search by city, locality, road, coaching institute, landmark, category and supported listing details.
- Nearby results depend on available listing coordinates. A distance written in listing text is provider-supplied information and should be confirmed before relying on it.

## Search and listing guidance

StudentHubHelp listing information can change. Availability, prices, facilities, timings, contact details and other important information should be reconfirmed with the relevant property owner or service provider before making a decision.

The “Verified & Active” label is reserved for listings marked verified and active in the platform's source data. It is not a guarantee of future availability, service quality or safety. Listings without that status should not be described as verified.

Do not infer ratings, reviews, amenities, prices or exact distances when they are not shown on the listing.
